## About
Sergio's Concrete Work began as a small family business, and it's still led by founder Sergio Hernandez. We do residential and commercial concrete, from driveways and sidewalks to foundations, stamped concrete and demolition.
Our yard is on County Rd 583A in Alvin, and we work in Pearland, Lake Jackson and the towns around them. Every job starts with a consultation, where we listen to your ideas and walk the site before we plan anything.
Neighbors have given us a 4.9 rating from 140 Google reviews. They mention fair prices, a crew that shows up on time, and Sergio staying in touch from the first call to the cleanup.

## Services
- Concrete Driveway Building: New driveways built with proper grading, excavation, sturdy forms and rebar or wire mesh, then poured and leveled for a smooth surface.
- Concrete Sidewalk Building: Sidewalks and walkways laid out, formed and reinforced. One reviewer praised the clean lines and smooth finish on her new sidewalk.
- Concrete Foundation: Foundation work for homes, barns and buildings, including slab foundations and metal building slabs.
- Concrete Installation & Repair: We replace damaged sections and add on to what you have. One customer said the new work blends perfectly with the existing concrete.
- Stamped Concrete: Decorative stamped concrete for driveways and patios. We can also repair damaged stamped areas and match the existing look.
- Custom Concrete Patio Extension: More room out back with a patio extension built to fit your yard.
- Demolition and Removal: We break out old concrete and haul it off, leaving your site clean and ready for the next phase.
- Tractor work and dirt work: Site prep with our own tractor work and dirt work before the concrete goes down.

## FAQ
Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We're based in Alvin and work in Pearland, Lake Jackson and the surrounding areas.

Q: Do you do commercial jobs too?
A: Yes. We take on residential and commercial concrete work.

Q: Is the estimate free?
A: Yes. Call us or send a note through the contact form and we'll set up a free estimate.

Q: What if my job needs a permit?
A: That's not a problem. One customer needed a permit for their job and said it was no issue for Sergio.

Q: I called and couldn't reach Sergio. What should I do?
A: Please try again. Sergio stays busy on job sites, and one reviewer put it plainly: be persistent, he will get back to you.
